patch.value: Compile packed contracts against each exact selected SDK bound

Follow-up to PR 153: packed declarations resolved SDK imports from a current-only consumer installation, leaving the minimum bound untested. Isolate each runtime and bound, verify the installed resolution, and regress a current-only public SDK API.

Exact manifest minimum and explicit current SDK resolve inside separate packed npm and Bun consumers; a newer-only public API passes current and fails minimum; reverting only consumer provisioning fails the regression.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation now removes the empty declaration and delegates exports resolution to real TypeScript namespace probes scoped to the selected SDK, with no paths mapping in the probes. Only natively resolved files are rebound into external declarations. Probe failures retain real TypeScript codes even when dependency skipLibCheck would hide an unresolved import. Mutation controls cover eight cases at both 2026.10.17 and 2026.10.24: nonexistent subpath, removed exported subpath, misspelled package (TS2307); missing named/type-only exports (TS2305); type exported without a runtime value (TS2693); type-only import used as a value (TS1361); default versus namespace import (TS1192). Good authoring/read/namespace consumers must pass. Additional tests cover minimum-only subpath removal, hidden unresolved external imports, native string/conditional/wildcard/null/missing-file exports, and self-test rejection of both a blind compiler and a stubbed resolution probe. Typecheck, test compilation, lint, docstrings and zero-duplication checks passed before final behavioral verification.
